limitations: Evidence class: software measurement on ref-x86-64 (TRS2). Each admitted pair is solved once, on one registered or constructed minimal flowsheet; a VERIFIED solve shows the pair works there, not across the basis' domain. Not validation.
No D/A requirement: X10 inventory (ADR 0056 row 9, R-925) is a measurement package, so requirements is empty.

CoolProp is represented by R134a (docs/X10_DECISIONS.md D-1). Its coolprop_extra_present section was measured with CoolProp 8.0.0 from requirements-coolprop.lock installed into a scratch pip --target directory on PYTHONPATH, not in the shared .venv (D-3).
c1.reactor and c1.reactor_standin bind on revision_coupled and are not solved: the probe runs no external-unit experiments (D-4).

c1.reactor_surrogate solves CONVERGED but UNVERIFIED on its registered revision (benchmarks/m04/c1-surrogate.json; derivative_witness.on_pattern 0.109 against 1e-7). Measured cause (X10 review): the witness step h = 3e-5 mol/s is set by the column scale, against per-tube flows of 1.4e-4 to 4.9e-3 mol/s; the Jacobian-minus-finite-difference error falls 4.00x per halving of h, so it is truncation, not a Jacobian defect. User-facing (support matrix L-X10-1, class E). A design-lane follow-up (scaling and certificate policy) owns the step's rule.
The 'lifted by S10-C/S11?' column and the register reasons in docs/X10-inventory.md are register readings encoded in the generator (D-7), not measurements.

Review-fix round (docs/reviews/X10-review.md, docs/X10_DECISIONS.md D-8..D-13): the CoolProp-present section was not re-measured after the fixes; benchmarks/x10/inventory.json is byte-identical (sha256 unchanged), so its --check in that environment is the committed one's (X10.I2 of the first manifest).
